assets={

import pathlib,json,time,asyncio
import aiohttp
R=pathlib.Path(__file__).parent
F=json.loads((R/"freeze.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
async def main():
    deadline=F["overall_started_epoch"]+1800
    while time.time()<deadline and not (R/"shutdown.json").exists():
        try:
            async with aiohttp.ClientSession(timeout=aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=None,sock_connect=3)) as s:
                async with s.ws_connect("http://127.0.0.1:8197/ws?clientId="+F["job"],heartbeat=10) as ws:
                    with (R/"native-events.jsonl").open("a",encoding="utf-8") as log:
                        while time.time()<deadline and not (R/"shutdown.json").exists():
                            try: msg=await asyncio.wait_for(ws.receive(),timeout=3)
                            except asyncio.TimeoutError:continue
                            if msg.type==aiohttp.WSMsgType.TEXT:
                                e=json.loads(msg.data)
                                e["observed_epoch"]=time.time()
                                log.write(json.dumps(e)+"\n");log.flush()
                            elif msg.type in (aiohttp.WSMsgType.CLOSED,aiohttp.WSMsgType.ERROR):break
        except (OSError,aiohttp.ClientError): await asyncio.sleep(1)
asyncio.run(main())

import aiohttp
R=pathlib.Path(__file__).parent
F=json.loads((R/"freeze.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
async def main():
    deadline=F["overall_started_epoch"]+1800
    while time.time()<deadline and not (R/"shutdown.json").exists():
        try:
            async with aiohttp.ClientSession(timeout=aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=None,sock_connect=3)) as s:
                async with s.ws_connect("http://127.0.0.1:8197/ws?clientId="+F["job"],heartbeat=10) as ws:
                    with (R/"native-events.jsonl").open("a",encoding="utf-8") as log:
                        while time.time()<deadline and not (R/"shutdown.json").exists():
                            try: msg=await asyncio.wait_for(ws.receive(),timeout=3)
                            except asyncio.TimeoutError:continue
                            if msg.type==aiohttp.WSMsgType.TEXT:
                                e=json.loads(msg.data)
                                e["observed_epoch"]=time.time()
                                log.write(json.dumps(e)+"\n");log.flush()
                            elif msg.type in (aiohttp.WSMsgType.CLOSED,aiohttp.WSMsgType.ERROR):break
        except (OSError,aiohttp.ClientError): await asyncio.sleep(1)
asyncio.run(main())
